meta.title: Enhanced Due Diligence: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Compare Enhanced Due Diligence availability and usability for the same Finance Controller on Growth and Enterprise plan tenants, including financial and credit-rating due diligence for high-value vendors.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Compare Enhanced Due Diligence availability and usability for the same Finance Controller on Growth and Enterprise plan tenants, including financial and credit-rating due diligence for high-value vendors.

args.need: sign in as the Finance Controller, verify Enhanced Due Diligence is unavailable on the Growth-plan tenant, then repeat on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify the same financial and credit-rating due diligence workflow works

steps.note: No catalog step can switch or identify plan tiers or operate the Enhanced Due Diligence capability.
Checks that the feature subject is visible after the tester performs the workflow, but does not establish the plan-dependent outcome.
